title: Teamwork in Sports & Soft 'g'

scenes.t: {name} reads a football story. Omar and his friends played football at school.
At first, they all wanted to score.
Then, their coach said, 'Work as a team!'
They started to pass the ball and help each other.
Omar passed to Karim, and Karim scored. Everyone cheered.
They didn't win alone — they won together. Teamwork made the game fun and fair.
Soft 'g' /dʒ/ usually comes before e, i, y: giraffe, Egypt, page, huge, magic.

items.a: The person who trains a team.
Kick the ball to a friend.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Put the story in order: match the number.
pairs: Omar and his friends played football.
Their coach said, 'Work as a team!'
They passed the ball and helped each other.
Omar passed to Karim, and Karim scored.

why.h: g before a, o, u or at the end.

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 91–93
